preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of vertices N in each test case must be between 1 and 15.
The number of edges M must be non-negative and less than the maximum possible edges in a simple graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= N and 1 <= Y <= N for X, Y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum values of x and y that satisfy the equation Ax = By.
The values of x and y must be positive integers.
The equation Ax = By must hold true for the output values of x and y.
